doc: Every code path that writes a CustomizationTable row is listed here with how it satisfies the module-provisioning standard. A new write site that is not listed fails scripts/check-module-completeness.mjs.

reasons.createTable (tx.customizationTable.creat: USER_CREATE — the only custom-module creation path; runs provisionModuleComponents inside one transaction.
reasons.updateTable upsert: SYSTEM_TABLE_OVERRIDE — upserts an existing SYSTEM table's overrides; not a new module.
reasons.syncDefaultSolution upsert: SYSTEM_SYNC — system modules, provisioned by seed-config/publishTenantDefaults, not by the custom plan.
reasons.ensureCustomizationTable upsert: SYSTEM_SYNC — lazily materialises a system table row.

reasons.applyBaseObjects createMany: PACKAGE_IMPORT — carries its own forms/views/columns from the source tenant. Default injection would overwrite the author's design; run reconcileModuleComponents afterwards if a package omits components. Known limitation, see docs/engineering/standards/module-provisioning.md.

reasons.seed upsert: SYSTEM_SEED — system modules declared in SYSTEM_CUSTOMIZATION_TABLES, verified by verify-seed-config.
